Business Description: Cadent Energy Partners, LLC is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in investments in PIPES, buyouts and acquisition, corporate divestitures, mature and expansion capital, spinouts, late venture, private or public company restructuring, turnarounds, and mergers and acquisition of small and medium sized businesses. The firm also seeks to invest in start-ups seeking to acquire and develop oil and gas properties. It prefers to invest in companies operating in the energy and natural resources sector. Within the energy sector the firm focuses on companies engaged in the hydrocarbon and power industries. In the hydrocarbon space, the firm invests in exploration and production which includes owners, developers, and operators of oil and gas reserves. It also invests in oilfield services and equipment, where it seeks to provide necessary capital to service providers, manufacturers, and distributors of products used in the development, production, gathering, transportation, maintenance, processing, refining, and distribution of hydrocarbons. The businesses in the oilfield and equipment space include: seismic equipment and services, drilling, well logging, well production, reservoir management, offshore supply and transportation, and rig equipment construction and maintenance. Additionally in the hydrocarbon industry it invests in midstream where investments are also sought in owners, developers, and operators of assets used to gather, transport, and process hydrocarbons such as natural gas and crude oil gathering, transportation, processing, and storage facilities. It also invests in downstream owners, developers, and operators of assets used to convert raw and intermediate hydrocarbons into end-products as well as distributors and marketers of the end-products, such as refineries, product pipelines, terminals, tankers, and retail and wholesale marketers. In the power industry the firm invests in power generation including owners, developers, and operators of assets such as conventional power plants (oil, gas, coal, hydro, and nuclear) and alternative power sources (wind, solar, and thermal) used to produce electricity. Power transmission investments are made in owners, developers, and operators of assets such as transmission lines, transformers, switchgear and monitoring systems used to transport power from the generation plants to local distribution systems. For power distribution, the firm invests in owners, developers, and operators of assets such as power lines, transformers, switchgear, metering and monitoring systems used to distribute power from the transmission systems to individual end users. Within the power services and equipment industry investments are made in service providers, manufacturers, and distributors of products used in the development, operation, and maintenance of power generation, transmission, and distribution facilities. Within the power services and equipment sector, the firm’s investments comprise of generation equipment and associated spare parts, monitoring and measurement systems, cleaning and maintenance services, engineering and construction, meter reading, power line maintenance and testing, transformer and electrical equipment refurbishment, and disposal services. It typically holds its investments over a period of four to seven years and exits through strategic sales, IPO’s, and leveraged recapitalizations. Business Description: Established in 1983, Massachusetts Pension Reserves Investment Management Board is a Government Pension Plan Sponsor.
